messages.subject: Unique session/ user id tracking
parts:
Hi,
I am wondering if there is a way to get the user name or id during the session, so for different user, when the App runs and does file saving/loading, it will generate different files on the server? 
e.g, "trainedModel_userA.RData",  "trainedModel_userB.RData" will be generated for user A and B when they access the server and run the app.

Thanks.

Yinghao
